title: A Different Kind of Origin Story

entities.name: Eleni
entities.description: A young elf of the Knotvine tribe from Naya, lost on Jund, who grows into a warrior; the column reveals her as Nissa Revane.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A proud and ruthless nature-mage from Zendikar who seeks to prove that elves are the true heirs and best stewards of the planes; the tale presents her as the grown-up Eleni.

entities.name: The Wizard
entities.description: The unnamed narrator, a Magic creative designer who is pulled into Jund in a dream and cannot cast spells there.

entities.name: Undead Jundwurm
entities.description: A huge undead wurm of Jund that burrows after Eleni and the narrator, and comes back covered in lava.

entities.name: Knotvine tribe
entities.description: The elf tribe of Naya that Eleni comes from.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A volcanic, dragon-preyed world of Alara where Eleni is lost.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The paradise jungle shard of Alara from which Eleni comes.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane that holds Jund and Naya.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The world Nissa Revane hails from.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A being honoured by a sacred elvish monument on Naya; Eleni's pendant resembles it.

entities.name: Relic of Progenitus
entities.description: An eye-shaped pendant in Eleni's hair that destroys the undead wurm when she speaks a command word.

entities.name: Jund raid-clans
entities.description: Human warrior clans of Jund led by a blood-braided leader who welcome Eleni.

entities.name: Cylians
entities.description: A people known for sumptuous embroidery.

events.summary: The narrator, working on the Homelost Elf card late at night, finds himself transported into a cave on Jund after a power failure.
events.quote: I started as I realized my bed was no longer under me, either.

events.summary: The narrator meets Eleni of the Knotvine tribe, hiding from a wurm above.
Eleni asks the wizard to cast spells to save them, but he finds he has no mana on Jund; she says she knows where to find some.
events.quote: "I know where we can find some."

events.summary: The undead wurm bursts through the ceiling, splitting the tunnel between Eleni and the narrator.
events.quote: A seeming mile of rotting monster plunged through the earth between us

events.summary: The narrator leaps across the chasm toward the lava Eleni thinks is a mana source.
events.quote: I took a running start and leaped.

events.summary: The wurm emerges from the lava, draped in it, charging at them.
events.quote: A second later, the wurm was ahead of us, barreling toward us, glowing red.

events.summary: Fleeing back, the narrator slips and falls onto a ledge, trapped; Eleni refuses to leave him.
On the narrator's advice Eleni uses the relic of Progenitus, and the wurm disintegrates in ash.
events.quote: The wurm disintegrated in a mass of smoking ash, billowing apart as the lava consumed it.

events.summary: Eleni leads them to safety, negotiates with a human warrior clan, takes tattoos and becomes at home in Jund as a warrior.
The narrator wakes in his bedroom, finds the card art changed and renames the card as Nissa Revane.
events.quote: I changed its name, and signed off.

relations.note: Eleni is of the Knotvine tribe.
The wurm hunts them and Eleni destroys it.
relations.quote: The wurm disintegrated in a mass of smoking ash, billowing apart as the lava consumed it.
She hails from a world known as Zendikar
